counter_scope_limitation: Counters are capture-wide, not per-op latency; VC direction not inferred from VC number alone. Compare with source-derived payload and descriptor inventory.
bandwidth_scope_note: 7.38 TB/s per chip, two independent chiplets. Configured 3.7 TB/s is approximately half chip peak, not an extra full-chip factor of two.
root_cause: Parser discarded explicit compiler hbm-to-vmem comments before inference. Arithmetic/phi pointer types were not recovered, leaving 48 prefetch DMAs without direction, service or completion credits.
interpretation: A confirmed byte/credit omission, but zero wall-time change at configured 3.7 TB/s: these prefetched transfers fit under modeled compute. Does not causally explain the 31.73 us residual.

corrected_bandwidth_sensitivity.interpretation: Sensitivity, not a measured/calibrated effective DMA rate. Default bandwidth unchanged. The remaining gap is sensitive to DMA service parameters, not uniquely attributed.

output_flag_fix.cause: scalar_lea.sflag annotation parsed as displacement; composing offsets on nonzero allocation-relative flags unsupported
